name: Zul'Gurub: Arlokk's Razor Claws bleed ends when the bleeding player dies
contract: Arlokk's Razor Claws bleeds (2118326-2118329, 10 s) carry SPELL_ATTR3_ALLOW_AURA_WHILE_DEAD in the client DBC, so
they stayed on a dead player and killed them again right after a battle resurrection (tester 2026-11-04). A
player's bleed now ends with that player's death, like other harmful auras, so nothing is left to tick once

steps.label: DISCRIMINATING: the bleed ends with the hero's death
